About the Review

An independent paper for Vejer and the coast, written by the people who live here and read by the people who do not yet.

The Review began in 2016 as a four-page sheet pinned to the door of the harbour office. It has been a website since 2019.

We are paid by readers and by no one else.

The Vejer Review is published by a cooperative.
